data: Lord of the Rings: Books Only
Journey through Middle-earth as Tolkien wrote it — no films, no extras, just the pages of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings trilogy.
What is the name of the hobbit hole where Bilbo Baggins lives?
Bilbo Baggins lives at Bag End, Bagshot Row, Hobbiton, as established in the opening of The Hobbit.
Who is the wizard that recruits Bilbo Baggins for the quest to reclaim Erebor?
Gandalf arranges Bilbo's participation in the quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain in Chapter 1 of The Hobbit.
What is the name of the dragon who occupies the Lonely Mountain?
Smaug the Tremendous drove the dwarves from Erebor and hoards their treasure, as described in The Hobbit.
In The Fellowship of the Ring, what is the name of the inn in Bree where Frodo first meets Strider?
Frodo and his companions meet Aragorn (Strider) at The Prancing Pony inn in Bree in The Fellowship of the Ring.
What is the elvish name for the forest realm ruled by Galadriel and Celeborn?
Lothlórien is the golden-wooded realm of Galadriel and Celeborn, visited by the Fellowship in The Fellowship of the Ring.
What creature does Gollum call the One Ring?
Gollum obsessively calls the One Ring 'my precious' throughout both The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.
Into what volcanic mountain must the One Ring be cast to destroy it?
The One Ring can only be destroyed in the fires of Mount Doom (Orodruin) in Mordor, as revealed in The Fellowship of the Ring.
